استسقوا (form X)
# اِسْتَسْقَوْا (istasqaw) /is.tas.qaw/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَسْقَى (istasqā)
# اُسْتُسْقُوا (ustusqū) /us.tus.quː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَسْقَى (istasqā)
# اِسْتَسْقُوا (istasqū) /is.tas.quː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَسْقَى (istasqā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
